# Reims Control
> **Reminder**: This document is intended for use by air traffic controllers on the VATSIM network only and is exclusively for flight simulation purposes. It shall not be used for real-world air traffic control operations.
{.is-warning}

Reims Area Control Centre provides en-route air traffic control services within the upper airspace of north-eastern France. It also manages the sectors serving the major airports located within its area of responsibility.

![ccr_lfee_fl265-fl345.png](/doc-atc/lfee/acc/ccr_lfee_fl345-fl660.png =75%x){.align-center}

The Centre position may be split into two primary sectors: **North (N)** and **South (S)**. 

When the Centre position is operated as a single sector, the **Bandbox** sector assumes responsibility for all sectors described above.

In addition, during events or as operationally required, individual upper sectors may be opened and provide ATS within their respective vertical limits.

## Control Positions and Limitations
> **Reims Control** is an unrestricted position. Nevertheless, controllers are strongly encouraged to familiarize themselves with this documentation before providing the position.<br>
When no approach positions are staffed, Reims Control shall provide ATS to the underlying aerodromes in accordance with the top-down principle.
{.is-info}

```diagram

```




> The **North** sector shall not be opened independently. It may only be operated when **LFEE_CTR** is online.
{.is-danger}
